turns.text: Hey everybody, welcome back to High Level Listening.
turns.zh: 嘿，大家好，欢迎回到 High Level Listening。

turns.text: Uh today's lesson is especially good for you guys if you are feeling a little bit stuck in your B1 level, but you do have a very comfortable B1 intermediate level small talk and you want to move into that confident B2 English listening.
turns.zh: 呃，今天的课对你们特别有用，如果你觉得自己在 B1 水平有点卡住了，但你的 B1 中级闲聊已经很舒服了，你想进入那种自信的 B2 英语听力。

turns.text: So, for our students that are feeling a little bit stuck, this should be a very helpful lesson for you today.
turns.zh: 所以，对那些觉得有点卡住的学生来说，今天的课应该会很有帮助。

turns.text: Have you ever been chatting with someone about your daily life or your hobbies comfortably in English, but then the conversation turns to a deeper topic, and you suddenly feel stuck?
turns.zh: 你有没有过这种经历：用英语轻松地跟人聊日常生活或爱好，但话题一转到更深的内容，你突然就卡住了？

turns.text: Maybe you can understand everything, but when it's your turn to speak, you struggle to name ideas or you can't quite express what you really mean?
turns.zh: 也许你什么都听得懂，但轮到你说话时，你费劲地想表达观点，或者没法完全说出你真正想说的意思？

turns.text: If this sounds like you, then this video is for you.
turns.zh: 如果你有这种感觉，那这个视频就是为你准备的。

turns.text: What makes this a true B2 English listening lesson is the way that we speak.
turns.zh: 让这成为一堂真正的 B2 英语听力课的关键，在于我们说话的方式。
